senses.gloss:
ind. [गते अहनि नि°] Yesterday. 
-Comp. 
-भव a. what occurred yesterday.

a. 
(-नी f.) Belonging to yesterday; as in ह्यस्तनी वृत्तिः, ह्यस्तनेन च कोपेन शक्तिं वै प्राहिणोन्मयि [[Mb. 5. 184. 4.]] 
-Comp. 
-दिनम् yesterday, the previous day.
a. Belonging to yesterday, hesternal; [[P. IV. 2. 105.]]
